proposals.title: Proposal Seeking a Report Regarding How We Select the Countries In Which We Operate or Invest
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the Board review guidelines for selecting countries/regions for operations and issue a report to shareholders by December 2016 on criteria for investing in, operating in and withdrawing from high-risk regions.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.
